decisions.statement: A passage that is not alone in the body is refused.
A passage the body has nowhere is refused.
A passage of no characters is refused.
A path with no body is refused.
A change leaving the body as the body was is refused.
The body worked on is the body the world answers rather than the body on disk.
Nothing here judges what the passage put in leaves.
The calling change judges what the passage put in leaves.

definition: one passage of one body replaced by another, with nothing else judged
